reply.critique: All five are NYC open mics that welcome music or comedy, and the first is the only dated event, free through NYC Parks. The Jalopy listing has a street address, a weekly schedule and sign-up times from the venue itself. EastVille has no street address, which is a weakness, but it is daily and from an organization, so a comparable community-list mic with an address (such as SoHo Playhouse) is not clearly better. The Boston and New Jersey mics were rightly left out for an NYC artist, and the Craigslist-style copied-in mic listings state nothing beyond a date.
